root_causes.description: Payment service exhibits extreme memory usage anomaly (z=+8.97) with window mean 1.395e+08 bytes against baseline 1.394e+08±1.6e+04, indicating severe memory pressure likely to cause OOM kills.
Quote service shows extreme p99_latency_ms z-score (>1000) vs baseline 1.98±2.9e-16, though actual p99=4.516ms suggests baseline artifact requiring further investigation.
Shipping service shows elevated p99_latency_ms z=+4.85 and cpu_usage z=+1.24, consistent with downstream dependency pressure from quote service latency anomalies.

remediation_steps: Investigate payment service memory pressure - check for memory leaks, increase resource limits, or review recent deployments that may have introduced excessive memory consumption
Monitor quote service latency - if p99 persists above baseline, investigate quote product-catalog dependency and potential slow queries or catalog indexing issues
Review shipping service dependencies - check quote service health and implement circuit breakers if downstream latency continues
